variables.E: Weld joint efficiency factor per Table A-1B

subsections.title: Straight Pipe Under External Pressure
subsections.equation: Per ASME BPV Code Section VIII, Division 1, UG-28
activities: Verify wall thickness against external loads
Consider vacuum conditions for cryogenic service

subsections.title: General Requirements
activities: Verify material suitability for service temperature
Confirm material listed in Table A-1

subsections.title: Low Temperature Toughness Tests
activities: Perform Charpy V-notch tests at MDMT

subsections.title: Welding Qualifications
activities: Qualify welding procedures (WPS) per ASME IX

subsections.title: Weld Quality Acceptance
activities: Evaluate weld quality vs acceptance criteria

subsections.title: General

subsections.title: Welding Procedure Specification (WPS)
activities: Document PQR with mechanical test results
deliverables: PQR with tensile, bend, impact results

Qualify NDE personnel to SNT-TC-1A Level II/III

subsections.title: Hydrostatic Testing

Leak test with soap solution or tracer gas

standards.title: Bioprocessing Equipment (Ultra-Clean Systems)
standards.scope: Surface finish, welding, and documentation requirements for high-purity process systems

subsections.title: Internal Surface Finish Requirements
subsections.specification: Ra ≤ 0.4 μm electropolished (EP) for process contact surfaces

subsections.title: Electropolish Requirements
activities: Select EP vendor with BPE experience
Specify EP parameters (current density, electrolyte, time)
Measure Ra before and after EP

subsections.title: Orbital Welding Requirements
activities: Develop orbital WPS per ASME IX + BPE supplementary
Purge with inert gas (Ar or He) to <5 ppm O₂

subsections.title: Weld Acceptance Criteria
activities: Compare to BPE weld acceptance color chart

standards.title: Non-destructive testing — Leak testing — Tracer gas method
standards.scope: Leak detection methodology for pressurized and vacuum systems

methods.procedure: Evacuate test volume, spray helium externally, detect helium ingress with mass spectrometer
methods.equipment: Helium leak detector (mass spectrometer), calibrated standard leak
methods.acceptance: Leak rate < specified value per RTM/specification
deliverables: Leak test report with serial numbers
Calibration certificates for detector and standard leak

methods.procedure: Pressurize with helium, use sniffer probe externally to locate leaks
methods.acceptance: No detectable leak above background at specified sensitivity

methods.procedure: Pressurize system with test gas, monitor pressure decay over 24 hours minimum
methods.acceptance: ΔP < calculated allowable based on volume, temperature stability, and required leak rate

methods.procedure: Enclose component in sealed chamber, accumulate leaked gas, measure concentration increase

sections.title: Test Report Requirements
sections.content: Test reports shall include: test object identification, test method, equipment used (type, serial number), calibration status, test conditions (temperature, pressure), test results, acceptance criteria, pass/fail decision, operator and supervisor signatures, date.

standards.title: Pressure Equipment Directive
standards.scope: Placing on the market and putting into service of pressure equipment and assemblies with maximum allowable pressure PS > 0.5 bar

articles.title: Classification of Pressure Equipment

tables.title: Gases — Group 2 (Helium, non-dangerous)
tables.description: Classification based on PS × V product for vessels

SEP.condition: PS × V ≤ 50 bar·L or PS ≤ 1000 bar and V ≤ 1 L
SEP.description: Sound Engineering Practice — no PED assessment

Category_II.description: Internal production control + monitoring (Module A2 or D1 or E1)

Category_III.description: EU-type examination + PPC (Module B+E or B+C2 or H)

Category_IV.condition: PS × V > 3000 bar·L or PS > 1000 bar
Category_IV.description: EU-type examination + production QA (Module B+D or B+F or G or H1)

tables.title: Piping — Gases — Group 2
tables.description: Classification based on PS × DN for piping

Category_III.description: Module B+D, B+F, G, or H1

activities: Calculate PS × V for each vessel/assembly
Calculate PS × DN for each piping run

articles.title: Essential Safety Requirements (ESR)

requirements.title: Design for adequate strength
requirements.description: Design calculations using allowable stress method with safety coefficients: ≥2.4 for austenitic stainless steel, ≥1.5 for yield

requirements.title: Means of examination
requirements.description: Equipment shall be designed to permit internal examination (manholes, inspection ports) — relates to RTM-060

requirements.title: Manufacturing
requirements.description: Traceability of materials from MTR to finished component

requirements.title: Corrosion/erosion protection
requirements.description: Surface treatment, electropolish per ASTM A967 — relates to RTM-061

requirements.title: Provision for draining and venting
requirements.description: Adequate provisions for draining, venting, and purging — relates to cryogenic gas systems

requirements.title: Permanent joining
requirements.description: Qualified welding procedures, qualified welders, NDE of permanent joints

requirements.title: Marking
requirements.description: CE marking with Notified Body number, identification plate, maximum/minimum allowable limits

activities: Document compliance with each applicable ESR
Prepare Technical File content for each ESR

H1.title: Full quality assurance with design examination

articles.title: CE Marking
requirements: Affix CE marking to pressure equipment visible, legible, indelible
Include Notified Body identification number (Category II+)
Prepare and maintain Technical File for 10 years
Affix identification plate with operating limits
deliverables: Technical File (design calculations, material certificates, test reports, NDE results, risk assessment)
EU Declaration of Conformity signed by authorized representative
CE marking label/plate with NB number

standards.scope: Equipment and protective systems intended for use in potentially explosive atmospheres

subsections.title: Equipment Categories

categories.Category_1: Very high level of protection — Zone 0/20

standards.title: Metallic Industrial Piping
standards.scope: Design, fabrication, installation, and testing of metallic piping systems

standards.title: Standard Specification for Chemical Passivation Treatments for Stainless Steel Parts
standards.scope: Passivation of stainless steel to remove free iron and enhance corrosion resistance

subsections.title: Citric Acid Passivation
subsections.note: Environmentally preferred alternative to nitric acid

subsections.title: Water Immersion Test
activities: Immerse passivated part in water for 24 hours
Inspect for corrosion or rust staining

subsections.title: Ferroxyl Test (Free Iron Detection)
subsections.specification: Apply ferroxyl solution (potassium ferricyanide + nitric acid) to surface
subsections.acceptance: No blue staining within 15 seconds indicates pass

standards.title: Industrial Valves — Pressure Testing of Metallic Valves
standards.scope: Pressure testing procedures and acceptance criteria for industrial valves

subsections.title: Shell Test
activities: Pressurize valve shell with test medium

subsections.title: Seat Test (Closure Test)

Rate_D.rate: Specified drops/min or cm³/min per DN

Rate_F.rate: As agreed between purchaser and manufacturer

activities: Apply test pressure to upstream side
Record results per valve serial number

subsections.title: Gas Seat Test
subsections.procedure: Apply gas pressure (air, N₂, or He) to one side; measure leakage on other side
subsections.duration: Minimum 15 seconds for DN ≤ 50, up to 120 seconds for DN > 600
subsections.acceptance: Per specified leak rate class (A through F)
activities: Set up valve in test fixture
Record and compare to acceptance criteria

rtm_to_standards_mapping.requirement: Max leak rate to ambient/INVAC: 1×10⁻⁹ mbar·l/s
Max 1 Nm³/day system helium loss; system leak rate <1×10⁻⁵ mbar·l/s
rtm_to_standards_mapping.test_method: He mass spectrometer + pressure hold test

rtm_to_standards_mapping.requirement: Valve leak rates per Table 6 (seat: 1×10⁻⁴, ambient: 1×10⁻⁹)
Functional test under simulated LOOP conditions
rtm_to_standards_mapping.test_method: Pressure hold + He sniffing under thermal cycling
rtm_to_standards_mapping.deliverable: SAT report with thermal cycle data

rtm_to_standards_mapping.acceptance: Adequate access for internal examination per ESR
rtm_to_standards_mapping.deliverable: GA drawings showing manhole locations, dimensional report

rtm_to_standards_mapping.requirement: Surface treatment — passivation per ASTM A967
rtm_to_standards_mapping.deliverable: Passivation certificate, ferroxyl test photos, material cert

rtm_to_standards_mapping.requirement: Piping design for cryogenic helium service

rtm_to_standards_mapping.acceptance: No leakage, no permanent deformation at test pressure

rtm_to_standards_mapping.requirement: Measuring points per Table 10 — sensor specifications
rtm_to_standards_mapping.test_method: Sensor calibration and EMC type test
rtm_to_standards_mapping.deliverable: Calibration certificates, EMC type test reports
